name: Stiff-Vector Kinetic with e^-y Screened Frame Coupling
claimed_mechanism: This architecture introduces a stiff timelike vector field u_mu with an independent, unscreened kinetic normalization (M^2). The preferred-frame coupling to matter is strictly multiplied by the screening factor e^-y = 1-mu(y), ensuring PPN observables vanish in the high-acceleration limit (P2 compliance). Because the kinetic term for u_mu is independent of the screened coupling, the P7 collision is avoided: the kinetic normalization remains finite (M^2) even as the screening factor drives the PPN response to zero. The MOND dynamics are realized via the auxiliary-Legendre chi field, which modifies the spatial metric structure to yield the correct nonlinear force law without introducing additional propagating DOF beyond the stiff vector.
predicted_weak_field: In the weak-field, high-acceleration limit (y >> 1), the screening factor e^-y suppresses the preferred-frame coupling exponentially, driving alpha_1, alpha_2 -> 0. The stiff vector u_mu propagates as a massless (or stiff) mode with sound speed c_s ~ c, independent of the MOND screening. Lensing is determined by the spatial metric modifications from the MOND sector, yielding the correct Bekenstein-like lensing enhancement (M5/M1=4) due to the non-conformal structure of the MOND potential. The Newtonian limit is recovered with G_eff/G_N = 1, and the tensor sector remains standard GR (c_T=1).
inequivalence_argument: This candidate is inequivalent to DC-002 (AeST) because the preferred-frame coupling is screened by e^-y, not constant, and the kinetic normalization is independent of the screening factor (avoiding the alpha_2 ~ 1/K_B kill). It is inequivalent to DC-001 (local no-frame) because it includes a preferred-frame carrier (u_mu) with screened coupling, escaping the pincer theorem. It is inequivalent to DC-003 (lapse-weighted) because no coupling is lapse-weighted. It is inequivalent to DC-010 (finite-alpha khronometric) because the kinetic normalization is independent of the screened coupling, avoiding the P7 strong-coupling wall. It is inequivalent to FM-000004 because the vector field has a standard kinetic term with independent normalization, not a decoupled propagator with vanishing longitudinal kinetic.
